learn_phase.observation: Kortex can extract user or system directives into provenance-linked durable memory, while its architecture defers automatic policy rewriting and its current directive schema has no review lifecycle.

proposal.change: Before any consumer treats extracted directives as policy, add explicit candidate, reviewed, rejected, and promoted lifecycle semantics with source provenance and rollback behavior.
